objects.taxonomy_description: Adult castrated bovine measuring 140-180 cm at withers weighing 400-900 kg. Body massive and muscular with short dense coat in white, brown, black, or pied coloration. objects.taxonomy_description: Large wading bird measuring 120-145 cm in height with wingspan reaching 140-170 cm. Plumage ranges from pale pink to vivid scarlet depending on diet, with darker coloration on wings and tail. Neck is extremely elongated and S-curved, comprising approximately one-third of total body length. Bill is distinctive with downward-curving shape, deep black at tip transitioning to pale pink at base, adapted for filter-feeding. Legs are exceptionally long and bright pink to red with webbed feet. Body exhibits bilateral symmetry with compact torso contrasting elongated neck and legs. Wings display black primary feathers visible during flight. Flight posture features full neck extension. Juveniles display grey-white plumage developing pink coloration over 2-3 years. Weight ranges 2-4 kg.

objects.taxonomy_description: Edible fungus with a characteristic cap-and-stem morphology. The cap (pileus) is convex to flat, typically 3-10 cm in diameter, with a smooth or slightly scaly surface in white, brown, or tan coloration. The underside reveals gills (lamellae) radiating from the stem, ranging from white to dark brown. The cylindrical stem (stipe) is smooth, firm, and white, typically 3-8 cm in length. The overall form is umbrella-like with a fleshy, moist texture.
